"With reference to the business altercation on Whangpoo and Wayside wharves, we beg to submit the following account:-

Consequently, we had a dispute over the matter and it was amicably settled through the mediation of the said wharf manager, the sum of $200.00 to be paid to the manager of the Li Li Garage for expenses incurred by him. The said money was converted by them to the "Sz Yuh" Hospital for charity purposes.

The total expenses we incurred was $905.00. In order to avoid further trouble, and at the request of the Japanese we obtained thirty-three licenses, the cost of each being $30.00, from them, total amount being $990.00.
For the sake of supporting our families, we raised the above sum in the hope that we could obtain a living.

Commencing on March 1, 1935, the Management of
the N.Y.K. Wayside Wharf granted the Yellow Taxicab Company
of China Incorporated, with head offices at 534 Rue
Bourgeat, the sole right of operating on the company's
wharf. This step was taken to eliminate the nuisance
caused to passengers and others by touts and chauffeurs
of small garages in that vicinity.

Since this concession was granted to the Yellow
Taxicab Company, several acts of intimidation against the
chauffeurs of the garage have occurred in various parts
of the Settlement and in one or two instances cars have
been damaged. This is believed to have been carried out
of

自从授予黄色出租车公司这一特许权以来，在租界各地发生了几起针对该车行司机的恐吓行为，在一两起事件中车辆受损。据信，这是由被禁止在码头运营的不满车行老板唆使进行的。

1935年3月15日晚上10时15分，三名讲宁波话的中国男子在公司位于南外滩28号的分站租用了一辆车牌号为12042的黄色出租车，支付现金1.00元，并指示该司机开车送他们去开封路。到达北苏州路以北约50码的甘肃路30弄入口时，司机被指示停车。他的三名乘客随即命令他离开驾驶座。此时，六七名中国男子从巷子里出来包围了司机，随后那三名也已下车的乘客用其中一人从大衣口袋里拿出的一根绳子将司机的双手绑在背后。他们还威胁要挖掉司机的眼睛。从巷子里出来的那些人接着将两块包在纸里的砖头扔进车内。司机被告知将此事项报告给黄色出租汽车公司经理，并禁止今后驾驶该公司的汽车，否则将面临人身伤害。他还被指示通知经理关闭位于贝加尔路和杨树浦路拐角处的公司分站。随后，巷子里的两名男子解开了司机的双手，所有人沿甘肃路30弄向东逃跑，该弄通向浙江北路。司机随即驾车离开，并向界路分站的赵永源报告了这一事件。

Intimidation against the Yellow Taxicab Company
of China Incorporated

Commencing on March 1, 1935, the Management of
the N.Y.K. Wayside Wharf granted the Yellow Taxicab Company
of China Incorporated, with head offices at 534 Rue
Bourgeat, the sole right of operating on the company's
wharf. This step was taken to eliminate the nuisance
caused to passengers and others by touts and chauffeurs
of small garages in that vicinity.

Since this concession was granted to the Yellow
Taxicab Company, several acts of intimidation against the
chauffeurs of the garage have occurred in various parts
of the Settlement and in one or two instances cars have
been damaged. This is believed to have been carried out
of
at the instigation/disgruntled garage owners debarred from
operating on the wharf.

a Yellow Taxi car from a branch garage and drive to a
certain alleyway where the passengers are joined by fellow
intimidators and assault the chauffeur, threatening drastic

针对中国黄出租车股份有限公司的恐吓行为

自1935年3月1日起，日本邮船会社 (N.Y.K.) 汇山码头管理处授予总部位于蒲石路534号的中国黄出租车股份有限公司在其码头运营的独家权利。采取此举是为了消除该地区小车库的拉客者和司机给乘客及其他人士造成的滋扰。

自从给予黄出租车公司这一特许权以来，在租界各地发生了几起针对该车库司机的恐吓行为，在一两起事件中车辆受损。据信这是由被禁止在码头运营的失意车库车主唆使/所为。

恐吓者最新采用的方法是，从一家分行车库租用一辆黄出租车，驶至某条弄堂，乘客在那里与同伙会合并袭击司机，威胁如果司机继续为公司服务，将采取严厉行动。
